Olord has only joined Eric McNamara this year and gave plenty of encouragement when finishing well to beat all bar Shadow Paddy over 2m1f at Tipperary this month. River Vale and Bal Kauto are others to note.

selections.comment: FREE FLOW shaped well twice in maiden hurdles at Punchestown earlier this year and seemed to appreciate the better ground when scoring at Thurles. He drew clear in the closing stages to suggest this step up in trip should suit. Howdoyalikeherhome won over 2m6f at Down Royal last month and again ran with credit subsequently over this trip at Killarney. Miss Corby won a maiden hurdle last time, while Chef's Kiss and Meet My Loreley are others to consider.

James Smith claims a valuable 5lb and she gets the vote over Dunany Point who landed a major gamble at Bellewstown before filling the runner-up spot off a revised mark at Sligo. Inchidaly Copper won a 2m5f handicap hurdle at Downpatrick back in 2022 and has been exclusively campaigned over fences in the past year winning three of his last five starts over a variety of trips. Ballinoe Blaze and Lough Nigara are others to consider.

selections.comment: SAMBA TRAIN was far from disgraced on debut over hurdles before running a cracker when switched to a bumper at Cork earlier this month. The selection was prominent throughout when beating all bar Woodland Adventure with Master Sydney three and a half lengths behind in third and Boogie On Down seventh. Woodland Adventure's trainer Gordon Elliott is now represented by Poetic Twist, a half-sister to bumper winner Starzand, and market support would be significant. The form of Courtmac Gesture's debut third to Sunny South West at Clonmel has been working out well, while Isabella Johnson filled the runner-up spot twice last month and looks capable of winning a summer bumper.

selections.comment: Smart hurdler GAOTH CHUIL ran a nice race on her debut over fences in Kilbeggan when chasing home a decent mare in Look To The West. She's not the biggest so the smaller fences around here should suit her well. The drop in trip would be a slight concern as she has won over as far as 2m7f. Amanha could be the danger on her chase debut. She won over timber at Navan on her penultimate outing before finding life tougher in a valuable contest at Fairyhouse last month. On hurdles ratings she'd be second best. Femme Magnifique has to be respected coming from Willie Mullins's yard but has something to prove having been pulled up twice late last year.

selections.comment: THE LITTLE YANK ran well when last seen at Cork in January and he looks capable of scoring off this mark. The Westerner gelding had a career high rating of 130 a few years ago and coming here off a little break he can get back to winning ways in this grade. Priory Park bounced back to form when scoring at Limerick nine days ago and has to be respected off just a 5lb higher mark. Pipers Boreen also comes here in winning form, having scored over a similar trip here last month. She is only 3lb higher but probably wants rain.

selections.comment: ROBIN ELITE is interesting here on his return to the racecourse. The Champs Elysees gelding ran out an easy winner of a point-to-point at Dawstown earlier this month and is tried back on the track now off a lowly mark of 77. With Anna McGuinness taking off 7lb he has a feather weight in this. Ta Se Rua sprang a 33/1 shock in a hunters chase here last month. It will be interesting to see how he fares off a mark of 93. Miners Bridge ran well over hurdles here on his penultimate outing and, off a lower mark over fences, he has to be respected.

selections.comment: KAINSBOURG should be hard to beat now down in class. The Doctor Dino gelding ran in some strong maiden hurdles last season and was turned over at a short price when last seen at Fairyhouse last month. He can make amends for that defeat now. Sea Of Doubt has been runner-up on her last couple of outings, including here last month, and may give him most to do. Money for the Henry de Bromhead-trained newcomer, The Store Boy, would be interesting. The Blue Bresil gelding cost 68,000 euro as a store and is out of Mares Hurdle runner-up Midnight Tour.

selections.comment: MAY CALL YOU BACK is interesting here back over hurdles. The Walk In The Park gelding won on his first outing for Willie Mullins when taking a handicap chase at Tipperary last July but was beaten favourite when tried over further here on his subsequent outing. Back down in trip and off a lower hurdles mark he should be good enough to land a race of this standard. Good Bye Milan ran a nice race on her return to action at Tipperary recently and could be a danger. Applejack Poet is another coming here off a placed effort and has to be on the shortlist.

selections.comment: SUNSET BOULEVARD is obviously one of the lesser lights in Closutton but has shown enough to give him the winning of one of these 'unplaced' maiden hurdles. The Wings Of Eagles gelding didn't run too badly when fifth in a Bellewstown bumper last month and going a bit further over a jump now may help him. Willie Mullins also runs two others in the race. On Cloud Wine was very green early on at Killarney and may be capable of better. The Gordon Elliott-trained Yarraman Makarrata was mid-division in handicap company last time and has to be considered in this. If he runs near his mark of 100, he'll play a big part.

selections.comment: The well-bred LIADAWN may be able to make a winning start here for Willie Mullins. The Jukebox Jury filly is a half-sister to a smart mare in Williamstown Dancer, who was a Grade 3 winner over hurdles for the yard a couple of years ago. Early Bird ran well when fourth in a strong bumper at Leopardstown in early March and looks the pick of those that have run. That form got a boost recently with the Mullins-trained Hello Jean, who had been third then, winning at Wexford. Tricksofthetrade ran a solid race on her 'track' debut when third at Cork and is another for the shortlist.

Brecon Beacons should improve for her opener in a decent enough novice at Kempton earlier this month, she was just getting going too late from a wide draw. Shining Pearl has the experience edge in the field and has already placed on three occassions, connections will hope the addition of first-time blinkers has an effect, her final run of 2024 was in a decent enough handicap at Newmarket so a repeat of that can see her go close.

selections.comment: KING'S LYNN can land a first victory since May 2022 having slid to a very threatening mark. Andrew Balding's gelding had a decent 2024 despite no wins, with six placings and a few more close-up but out the frame efforts in very competitive events. A below par run trying 7f for just the second occasion last time can be easily excused given the poor trip, and a return to 6f is a big plus. Two of his four career wins (a paltry return for one so talented) have come here (over 5f) and a bold bid is predicted. The list of dangers is many and headed by Trilby, a dual course and distance winner who should relish the reutun to 6f and the unexposed but hugely progressive Durham Castle, who should get very competitive despite the hike in class. Fine Interview and Dakota Gold are others that need serious consideration

selections.comment: A competitive heat with all having some sort of a chance but nothing truly standing out, and a chance is taken with DEL RAY to find a bit of further improvement for the first time cheekpieces. George Boughey's filly put a poor pipe-opener behind her when a decent fifth of 11 last time back on turf. The ground was probably a bit lively then and she can take another step forward to land the spoils. Oolong Poobong is faered most. She made a hugely encouraging start to her campaign when just touched off in a head-bobber last time at Newcastle. Her sole win came there but turf is no issue having again been just denied at Doncaster on good ground on fianl start last year. On only her sixth start there's scope for a fair bit more. Callianassa is another who has very solid AW form but has to prove quite as effective on turf still. However, she's pretty unexposed on turf and the pick of it is not far behind AW levels. She's generally pretty consistent and looks likely to play a significant role. Arabian Leopard and Sea To Sky are others worthy of note

selections.comment: A field full of promise but none more so than SEA FOUNDER who impressed when landing a maiden victory last time after heavy market support. An opening mark of 80 for handicap debut looks on the generous side given the scope for improvement on only his fifth start. He looks to hold solid claims. Hyperchromatic should be able to play a big role and should shine again having progressed steadily in five runs and going down by a narrow margin over 7.5f at Beverley last time on just second handicap start. He can follow the selection home. Criminal Shore has a similar profile and looked well-weighted when beaten seeking a double last time but a 3lb rise for a defeat there might just be enough to deny a trip back to the winner's enclosure. He still gets marginal preferecne over Al Shababi and Hot Cash to fill the frame

Asian Star has been highly regarded since a bumper debut in a hot contest and though she didn't progress over hurdles she shaped with plenty of promise in a good race on chase debut. She was a winner here in that discipline and would've made a winning chase debut last autumn but for falling. With that reappearance run under her belt she is set to make amends.

Barryroe Madam may have won but for falling last time and completes the list of dangers.

Biddy Early met trouble when placed on debut at a huge price and may provide the biggest threat if improving as expected.

selections.comment: A strong race where the standard is set by GAOTH CHUIL who probably would've won on chase debut if ridden more vigorously. She is likely to find this trip on the sharp side but was a consistent handicap hurdler and will be tough to peg back if resuming positive tactics. Another likely to go on is Ma Belle Etoile a recent hurdles winner who goes chasing early in her career. Her yard's horses tend to improve for fences so she holds strong claims. Recent handicap hurdle winner Amanha isn't dismissed either on chase debut as she should get her desired strong pace to aim at.

selections.comment: PRIORY PARK landed a gamble last time and was worth more than the winning margin after idling in front so is expected to follow up down in trip off just 5lb higher. Course specialist Pipers Boreen is also feared having only gone up 3lb for her last win here with the forecast rain a plus. U Asking Me ran well for a long way on his chase debut and is entitled to come on for the outing. He can also make his presence felt.

selections.comment: An open race where a number could be extremely well handicapped. MAID ON THE MOON has been highly tried over fences on all of her starts and was running a huge race when coming down at Listed level on her debut. She is potentially thrown in on that and gets the verdict ahead of Kyle Valley who was caught on the post over 3m over hurdles last time by a rival who boosted the form next time. The form of her point win suggests that there is more to come over fences and she could be tough to peg back down in trip. Miners Bridge is yet to fire over fences but has been thriving of late over hurdles and returns to the larger obstacles off a lenient mark. He can fight for a place along with recent point winner Robin Elite who returns to rules off a basement mark.

He was a Group winner on the flat in France so should have a class edge on these. Sea Of Doubt showed a willing attitude behind an idling rival last time and will prove tough to peg back at a sharp track if allowed an easy lead. The Store Boy represents a top yard with a fine record here and is feared if supported in the betting ahead of his debut.

selections.comment: MAY CALL YOU BACK has a long absence to overcome but that isn't usually a problem for his top stable which she won on debut for over fences last summer. She failed to get home next time but can bounce back dropped to 2m on her hurdles return. Miss Oreo is another who has been in good form over fences and returns to hurdling off a generous mark. She holds fair claims but could probably do with some rain while the inconsistent Good Bye Milan is also feared. She did well to place on her reappearance and is entitled to come on for the outing.

selections.comment: Willie Mullins holds a strong hand here with Ellis Mor, On Cloud Wine and SUNSET BOULEVARD. It is the latter who appeals most having shaped with promise on both of his bumper runs which looked inadequate tests. He is taken to make a winning hurdles debut now stepped up in trip at the expense of Kotkito Bello who was outclassed in a hot novice last time but showed promise on his debut previously. He is another who has looked in need of this step up in distance.

selections.comment: The standard is set by Wild Mandate who has plenty of experience in this sphere placing on 4 of her 7 starts. She returns from hurdling and holds strong claims but could be vulnerable to a talented newcomer such as LIADAWN. Her yard has won the last couple of renewals of this and she is a half sister to a useful hurdler for the stable. She can get off the mark at the first time of asking with Early Bird who represents last year's winning yard and showed improved form last time completing the places.
